name: EVE
summary: The first robot from 1X (then Halodi Robotics): a two-armed humanoid torso on a self-balancing wheeled base, driven by 1X's own quasi-direct-drive actuators for safe, back-drivable motion. EVE was deployed for security and logistics from 2022 and served as the data and hardware testbed that led to the bipedal NEO.
notable: 1X's proving ground for low-cost back-drivable actuators
Deployed for site security and logistics
